set.body: Prove that domain modules can export plot specs or plot-ready data into graphics without depending on SVG. Candidate first target: design matrix/event plot export because design already has renderer-neutral data carriers. Acceptance: one domain-facing helper or example builds a Plot/Scene through the compiler, module dependency boundaries remain acyclic, and docs show the Plot -> Scene -> SVG workflow with JVM+JS graphics tests plus the relevant domain slice.
set.title: Graphics: add first domain-export integration path
